name: Nhất quán khử răng cưa

algorithm: Nhất quán khử răng cưa Analysis Algorithm
mechanism: Analyzes nhất quán khử răng cưa patterns to detect AI-generated content. Phân tích tính nhất quán mẫu khử răng cưa — AI thường tạo khử răng cưa quá mịn hoặc không đồng đều
parameters: Analysis type: pixel, Media: image, Confidence threshold: adaptive
accuracy: Moderate to High — 65-85% standalone, higher when combined with other methods
source: Research-based pixel analysis method for image forensics
useCase: Detection of AI-generated image through nhất quán khử răng cưa analysis
strengths:
• Effective pixel analysis technique
• Works well as complementary method
• Applicable to various image types
• Based on established research
limitations:
• May require sufficient image quality
• Best used in combination with other methods
• Performance varies with content type
